principle: Rhythmic collision through systematic desynchronization of temporal, spatial, and graphic registers that accelerate independently toward structural impossibility, producing intensification without spatial or temporal grounding.

nodes.label: Metric montage with variable unit length
nodes.description: Shot duration operates as rhythmic structure, systematically accelerating from 6.2-second average (exposition) to 1.4-second average (Steps climax) then decelerating to 3.1 seconds (finale), creating a measurable compression-expansion curve across runtime.
evidence: Shot counts per minute quantified across all five acts, ranging from 12 (exposition) to 60+ (Steps climax)
Opening averages 6.2 seconds per shot; mutiny 2.8 seconds; Steps massacre 1.4 seconds; finale 3.1 seconds
Steps sequence deploys three distinct metric zones: crowd descent 2-3s, soldier march 1-2s, carriage 0.5-1s at climax
rules: Temporal compression must pair with proportional spatial compression via tighter facial framing
Metric acceleration and temporal expansion must remain desynchronized, moving in opposite directions

nodes.label: Overlapping action temporal expansion
nodes.description: Single diegetic events fragment across multiple shots from different angles, extending screen duration 4.5 to 7 times beyond story time. The pince-nez breaking uses 7 shots and 14 seconds for a 2-second event; the carriage descent uses 42 shots and 90 seconds for roughly 20 seconds of story time.
evidence: Pince-nez sequence: 7 shots, 14 seconds screen time for approximately 2 seconds of story time, a 7:1 expansion ratio
Carriage descent: 42 shots, 90 seconds screen time for approximately 20 seconds diegetic time, a 4.5:1 ratio
rules: Overlapping action must coincide with spatial incoherence so expansion reads as multi-perspectival viewing rather than repetition

nodes.label: Tonal and graphic collision montage
nodes.description: Shots organize by visual opposition rather than spatial continuity: binary cuts between extreme grayscale values (80% to 20% luminance) in ABABAB patterns, and compositional diagonals that contradict across cuts (45-degree descending versus 30-degree ascending vectors forming X-patterns).
evidence: Officer confrontation alternates high-key and low-key extremes in an ABABAB pattern across 18 shots with no gradual transition
Twelve documented instances where adjacent shot diagonals form an X-pattern when superimposed in the Steps sequence
rules: Adjacent shots must oppose in luminance or vector; visual synthesis across cuts is prevented

nodes.label: Serialized scalar close-up progression
nodes.description: Faces advance through fixed scale increments from long shot to extreme close-up, with each step halving the number of visible faces. The spatial constriction mirrors the temporal constriction of metric montage, producing dual compression and exponential intensification.
evidence: Mourning sequence progresses long shot crowd to medium cluster of 5 to medium close-up of 3 to single face to eyes only
Pattern repeated four times across the harbor sequence with identical scalar intervals
Tightest facial framings coincide with 1.4-second average shot length; return to long shots coincides with 3.1-second finale

nodes.label: Vertical spatial stratification
nodes.description: The Steps sequence organizes bodies across six horizontal planes with strict hierarchical positioning: soldiers on the top plane only, crowd on planes 2-5, victims at ground level. The hierarchy is maintained across 170+ shots so that a single transgressive traversal registers structurally.
evidence: Soldiers occupy top two bands exclusively; crowd scatters across lower four; segregation maintained through 170+ shots until final breach
The baby carriage is the only element to traverse the full vertical range
rules: Hierarchical plane boundaries must be maintained across 170+ shots until the final breach

nodes.label: 180-degree rule violation as structural principle
nodes.description: Eyeline matches systematically disregard screen direction: sailors and officers both look the same screen direction across cuts, producing spatial impossibility. Repeated 8 times in the mutiny sequence; not continuity error but systematic refusal of spatial coherence.
evidence: Eyeline violation repeated 8 times in the mutiny sequence
Pince-nez sequence shots show spatially impossible eyeline matches with both parties looking left
rule_violations: Classical continuity 180-degree rule and eyeline match conventions

nodes.label: Silent release with no structurally controlled sound
nodes.description: The 1925 release had no structurally controlled sonic dimension. Sonic absence is load-bearing: temporal logic must function without auditory cues, forcing all metric information into shot duration and graphic rhythm, including 16:1 durational contrast ratios within the Steps sequence.
evidence: No sonic dimension structurally controlled in the 1925 release; later scores were supervised separately
Steps sequence alternates an 8-second sustained shot with 12 shots in 6 seconds, a 16:1 longest-to-shortest ratio functioning as visual syncopation

nodes.label: Fabric surfaces as kinetic indicators
nodes.description: Flags, sails, tarpaulin, and clothing register wind and movement against static architecture. The fabric-to-rigid surface ratio increases from 1:4 (opening) to 3:1 (finale), tracking metric acceleration and eventually exceeding compensatory necessity to become an autonomous structural element.
evidence: The flag occupies 15% of frame area across 22 shots, always in motion, against static stone steps and ship hull
Fabric-to-rigid ratio shifts from 1:4 to 3:1 across the runtime, tracking the 6.2s to 1.4s metric acceleration
Fabric presence increases in the final act even after metric acceleration already supplies kinetic information
rules: Fabric-to-rigid ratio must increase as shot duration decreases to maintain kinetic information density

nodes.label: Baby carriage descent through all six planes
nodes.description: The carriage is the only element traversing the full vertical range of the Steps, descending through all planes during the expanded central act. Its 42-shot descent occurs at 2.8-second average shot length, slower than surrounding material, inverting the compression-equals-intensification logic.
evidence: Carriage descent: 42 shots, 90 seconds screen time, only element to traverse all six planes
Kinetic climax occurs at 2.8-second average shot length, slower than the 1.4-second surrounding material
rules: The kinetic climax occurs at decelerated tempo (2.8s average) rather than maximum metric velocity (1.4s)
rule_violations: The metric system logic that compression equals intensification

nodes.label: Odessa Steps as architectural compositional grid
nodes.description: The steps function as a built-in compositional armature: horizontal step edges divide the frame into 6-8 parallel bands, and figures are positioned at band intersections, supplying the physical scaffold for vertical stratification.
evidence: Horizontal step edges divide the frame into 6-8 parallel bands with figures positioned at band intersections
Long-lens depth compression flattens the steps into graphic pattern of vertical rifle lines and horizontal step lines rather than navigable space

nodes.label: Five-act structure with asymmetric distribution
nodes.description: Five titled segments of unequal duration, with the central Odessa Steps act consuming roughly one-third of runtime while bookend acts compress. This macro-scale asymmetry is replicated at micro scale by the six-plane spatial hierarchy within the Steps sequence.
evidence: Act durations approximately 10, 12, 10, 20, and 8 minutes; the central act consumes one-third of runtime
The carriage traversal of all six planes occurs during Act IV, the expanded central section, creating fractal correspondence between spatial and temporal hierarchies

edges.rationale: Temporal expansion through overlapping action requires spatial incoherence via 180-degree rule violations to mask the temporal impossibility as multi-perspectival viewing rather than stuttering repetition.
Metric acceleration requires serialized scalar progression to maintain information density per unit time; as shot duration halves, facial framing must tighten proportionally.

Sonic absence forces metric information into visual parameters, making shot duration the sole temporal organizing principle and requiring 16:1 durational contrast ratios that would be redundant if musical tempo were present.
Graphic collision montage prevents visual synthesis across cuts, which enables metric acceleration to operate as one contradictory vector without resolving into coherent space-time.
Graphic collision montage prevents visual synthesis across cuts, which enables temporal expansion to operate against metric acceleration without the registers resolving into unified continuity.

Metric montage accelerates shots toward 1.4s while overlapping action expands single moments 4.5:1 to 7:1; the vectors move in opposite directions, and this maintained tension is the core desynchronization of the work.
Vertical spatial stratification must maintain hierarchical boundaries across 170+ shots to make the carriage descent through all planes structurally legible as transgression.

The kinetic climax occurs at decelerated 2.8-second tempo, slower than surrounding 1.4-second material, inverting the metric promise that compression equals intensification; the durational logic fails precisely where it should culminate.

As metric velocity increases with shorter shots, fabric-to-rigid surface ratios increase from 1:4 to 3:1 to maintain kinetic information density through visual motion markers; fabric also exceeds this function, surviving as autonomous element.
The six-plane stratification depends on the steps as built-in compositional armature: horizontal step edges divide the frame into parallel bands where figures are positioned and segregated.

The asymmetric five-act distribution replicates at macro scale the spatial hierarchy within the Steps sequence, a fractal correspondence in which the compressed-bookend expanded-center pattern reinforces the stratified plane structure.

violated: Metric acceleration and temporal expansion must remain desynchronized, moving in opposite directions

failure_modes.consequence: If metric montage and overlapping action synchronize their acceleration and expansion rates, the temporal contradiction collapses into simple fast cutting and the work becomes conventional continuity cinema.

If spatial continuity is maintained during overlapping action sequences, temporal expansion becomes legible as repetition error rather than multi-perspectival intensification; M2 loses its masking condition and fails.

violated: Adjacent shots must oppose in luminance or vector; visual synthesis across cuts is prevented

failure_modes.consequence: If graphic collision resolves into visual synthesis, the three measurement systems (metric, temporal, spatial) can unify into coherent space-time and the desynchronization mechanism fails; M1 and M2 lose their structural antagonist.

violated: The kinetic climax occurs at decelerated tempo (2.8s average) rather than maximum metric velocity (1.4s)

failure_modes.consequence: If the carriage descent occurs at maximum metric velocity instead of decelerated tempo, the inversion of compression-equals-intensification logic breaks and the kinetic climax reads as mere continuation of the acceleration curve rather than structural inversion.

violated: Fabric-to-rigid ratio must increase as shot duration decreases to maintain kinetic information density

failure_modes.consequence: If fabric motion markers decrease during metric acceleration instead of increasing toward the 3:1 ratio, kinetic information density drops as temporal units compress and the visual rhythm becomes illegible in the absence of sonic tempo cues.

If a structurally controlled auditory tempo were present, shot duration would no longer be the sole temporal organizing principle; the 16:1 durational contrast ratios become redundant and the metric montage loses its load-bearing status.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, the work becomes spatially continuous narrative cinema rather than rhythmically organized collision; the entire temporal architecture collapses and no other mechanism can replace its
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, single-perspective continuity editing replaces multi-angle fragmentation; the expansion ratios that define intensification through temporal impossibility disappear and the work loses its
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, shots organize by spatial logic and continuity rather than visual collision; the lighting alternations and diagonal vector contradictions that create meaning through graphic opposition
asserted_removal_tests.M4: If removed, dual compression breaks: temporal compression proceeds without matching spatial compression, information density per unit time drops during acceleration, and the exponential intensification effect weakens, though other mechanisms survive.
asserted_removal_tests.M5: If removed, the Steps sequence loses its visual hierarchy and the carriage descent loses legibility as transgression through all planes; the collision montage it serves loses its spatial scaffold within the sequence.
asserted_removal_tests.M6: If removed, overlapping action reads as stuttering repetition rather than a single extended moment seen from multiple vantages; the spatial incoherence that masks temporal manipulation disappears and M2 becomes legible as error.
